import importlib.metadata
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, metadata_path, results_path, filtered_path, target_path, info_path = sys.argv[1:]

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_path, index_col=0)

counts.index = counts.index.astype(str)
counts.columns = counts.columns.astype(str)
metadata.index = metadata.index.astype(str)

if counts.index.isna().any() or counts.index.duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Counts gene identifiers must be present and unique.")
if counts.columns.duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Counts sample identifiers must be unique.")
if metadata.index.isna().any() or metadata.index.duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Metadata sample identifiers must be present and unique.")
if set(counts.columns) != set(metadata.index):
    raise ValueError("Counts and metadata sample identifiers do not match.")
if "batch" not in metadata.columns or "sex" not in metadata.columns:
    raise ValueError("Metadata must contain batch and sex columns.")
if metadata[["batch", "sex"]].isna().any().any():
    raise ValueError("Batch and sex cannot contain missing values.")

metadata = metadata.loc[counts.columns].copy()
metadata["batch"] = metadata["batch"].astype(str)
metadata["sex"] = metadata["sex"].astype(str)
if set(metadata["sex"]) != {"F", "M"}:
    raise ValueError("The sex factor must contain exactly F and M.")
metadata["batch"] = pd.Categorical(
    metadata["batch"],
    categories=sorted(metadata["batch"].unique()),
    ordered=True,
)
metadata["sex"] = pd.Categorical(metadata["sex"], categories=["F", "M"], ordered=True)
metadata.index.name = "sample"

if counts.isna().any().any():
    raise ValueError("Counts contain missing values.")
if (counts < 0).any().any():
    raise ValueError("Counts contain negative values.")
if not all(pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(dtype) for dtype in counts.dtypes):
    values = counts.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    if not np.isfinite(values).all() or not np.equal(values, np.floor(values)).all():
        raise ValueError("Counts must be finite, non-negative integers.")
    counts = counts.astype(np.int64)

slots = max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=metadata,
    design="~batch + sex",
    refit_cooks=True,
    n_cpus=slots,
    quiet=True,
)
dds.deseq2()

stats = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["sex", "M", "F"],
    alpha=0.05,
    quiet=True,
    n_cpus=slots,
)
stats.summary()

design_columns = list(stats.LFC.columns)
sex_coefficients = [
    column for column in design_columns
    if str(column) == "sex[T.M]"
]
if len(sex_coefficients) != 1:
    sex_coefficients = [
        column for column in design_columns
        if str(column).startswith("sex") and "M" in str(column)
    ]
if len(sex_coefficients) != 1:
    raise ValueError(
        "Could not identify the single M-vs-F sex coefficient: "
        + repr(design_columns)
    )
coefficient = sex_coefficients[0]
contrast_vector = np.asarray(stats.contrast_vector, dtype=float)
coefficient_index = design_columns.index(coefficient)
nonzero_contrast = np.flatnonzero(np.abs(contrast_vector) > 1e-12)
if len(nonzero_contrast) != 1 or nonzero_contrast[0] != coefficient_index:
    raise ValueError(
        "The requested M-vs-F contrast is not the single sex coefficient: "
        + repr(list(zip(design_columns, contrast_vector)))
    )

# PyDESeq2's lfc_shrink() uses its default shrinkage method and default adapt=True.
# It is applied after summary() so testing columns remain from the unshrunk Wald fit.
stats.lfc_shrink(coeff=coefficient)

results = stats.results_df.copy()
results.index.name = "gene"
results = results[[
    "baseMean",
    "log2FoldChange",
    "lfcSE",
    "stat",
    "pvalue",
    "padj",
]]
if "FAM138A" not in results.index:
    raise ValueError("FAM138A is absent from the fitted result table.")

finite_lfc = np.isfinite(results["log2FoldChange"])
finite_base = np.isfinite(results["baseMean"])
filtered = results[
    finite_lfc
    & finite_base
    & (results["log2FoldChange"].abs() > 0.5)
    & (results["baseMean"] > 10)
]

results.reset_index().to_csv(results_path, sep="\t", index=False, na_rep="NA")
filtered.reset_index().to_csv(filtered_path, sep="\t", index=False, na_rep="NA")
results.loc[["FAM138A"]].reset_index().to_csv(
    target_path, sep="\t", index=False, na_rep="NA"
)

target = results.loc["FAM138A"]
try:
    version = importlib.metadata.version("pydeseq2")
except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
    version = "unknown"

with open(info_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write("method=pydeseq2\n")
    handle.write("pydeseq2_version=" + str(version) + "\n")
    handle.write("design=~batch + sex\n")
    handle.write("contrast=sex:M_vs_F\n")
    handle.write("coefficient=" + str(coefficient) + "\n")
    handle.write("lfc_shrinkage=default (apeglm in PyDESeq2)\n")
    handle.write("counts_input=BatchCorrectedReadCounts_Zenodo.csv\n")
    handle.write("samples=" + str(counts.shape[1]) + "\n")
    handle.write("genes=" + str(counts.shape[0]) + "\n")
    handle.write("filter=abs(log2FoldChange)>0.5 AND baseMean>10\n")
    handle.write("filtered_rows=" + str(filtered.shape[0]) + "\n")
    handle.write("FAM138A_baseMean=" + repr(target["baseMean"]) + "\n")
    handle.write("FAM138A_log2FoldChange=" + repr(target["log2FoldChange"]) + "\n")
    handle.write(
        "FAM138A_passes_filter="
        + str(
            bool(
                np.isfinite(target["log2FoldChange"])
                and np.isfinite(target["baseMean"])
                and abs(target["log2FoldChange"]) > 0.5
                and target["baseMean"] > 10
            )
        )
        + "\n"
    )
